snippet.title: Can You Build a Tavern Empire from Scratch? | Brew & Defend Demo
snippet.description:
Demo is OUT NOW ON STEAM! Try and wishlist Brew & Defend now! 🍻https://store.steampowered.com/app/4968510/BrewDefend/

Follow our studio on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/developer/sketchyrabbit

Join our Discord! 
https://discord.gg/ywR456y6e

Brew & Defend is a medieval tavern management game with tower defense mechanics. Build your supply chain, grow crops, brew beverages, and place taverns along the road to satisfy a parade of thirsty customers before they ruin your reputation! 🍻

Check out Space Gnomes! 🚀
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0j3957GjPrU
